AUTHOR: R. J. M. Veiga; J. M. F. Rodrigues
TITLE: Fine-Grained Fish Classification From Small to Large Datasets With Vision Transformers
REGION: Multiple: Australia (OzFish), Gulf of Mexico (SEAMAPD21), NW Mediterranean/Spain (OBSEA), Adriatic/Croatia, Taiwan (F4K), plus non-field sets
SPECIES: Varies by dataset: OzFish 425 classes, SEAMAPD21 110 classes, OBSEA 25 classes, Croatian 12, F4K 23, etc.
DATA: 14 public datasets / 19 subsets: OzFish, SEAMAPD21, OBSEA, Croatian Fish, Fish4Knowledge, QUT, WildFish, WildFish++, FishNet, FishNet Open Images, Fish-Pak, Fish-Gres, BDIndigenousFish2019, Large-Scale Fish Segmentation & Classification
V_EV: Sec. II-A: OBSEA platform 'Situated 20 meters below the surface and 4km off the coast of Vilanova i la Geltrú'
D2: 70/20/10 (predefined splits for FishNet and FishNet Open Images)
D_EV: Sec. III-A: 'a uniform split strategy was implemented with a generator seed of 42 ... 10% were set aside for model testing, 20% for validation, and 70% for training.'
R_EV: Sec. III-A: 'metrics corresponding to the top-1 accuracy of the combiner over the test set, which corresponds to 10% of each dataset.'
C_EV: Sec. III-A: results are 'top-1 accuracy of the combiner over the test set' (classification only, no per-instance threshold or reject option reported)
E_EV: Table 3/5: only top-1 accuracy, precision, recall, F1, MCC reported
ARCH: FGVC-PIM with Swin Transformer backbone + FPN, Weakly Supervised Selector, GCN Combiner
METR: top-1 accuracy, precision, recall, F1 (macro/weighted), MCC; 10 seeds for some datasets
NOTE: Multi-dataset fine-grained classification on cropped fish images; INCL=Y because own results are reported for field monitoring datasets (OzFish BRUV crops, SEAMAPD21 BRUV, OBSEA cabled observatory), but most of the 14 datasets are benchmark/market/web collections - verifier should confirm eligibility. Each dataset trained and tested separately on a random image-level split (seed 42), so no external test. V2=Y rests only on the OBSEA dataset description (20 m depth). FishNet Open Images reported to contain >10,000 duplicates; removal not stated (D3=NR). Paper (Sec. II-A) describes FishNet Open Images as on-board vessel imagery. PRE not explicitly stated in extracted text.
